title: Art. 6.17 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 6 - International Airports - Facilities and Services for Traffic, B. Airport traffic flow arrangements, III. Outbound passengers, crew and baggage, 6.17
content:
Recommended Practice. Each Contracting State should ensure that security and/or border control personnel use efficient screening and examination techniques in examinations of passengers and their baggage, in order to facilitate aircraft departure.

Note. Privacy for the passenger should be assured during any physical searches required. Private rooms are preferable; however portable screens may be used. Physical searches should be conducted by an officer of the same sex as the passenger.
